name: special-education-due-process-complaint
description: Special Education Due Process Complaint Writer — a free AI plugin and skill for Claude and ChatGPT that drafts an IDEA special education due process complaint from a child's IEP, school documents and other important information, checks every date, figure and quotation against them, and delivers a PDF to file and a Word file to edit.
author: Mark Beekman (https://github.com/b33kman)
